job.job_description:
Job Summary

Shape how our AI systems think and respond. Youll design, test, and optimise prompts across LLMs (GPT-4, Claude, Gemini) to power AI agents, chatbots, and automation workflows for our clients.

Responsibilities
Design and iterate on prompts for LLM-based products (agents, chatbots, automation)
Evaluate model outputs and optimise for accuracy, tone, and efficiency
Build prompt libraries and document best practices
Work with the AI engineering team to embed prompts into production pipelines
Run structured experiments to measure prompt performance
Stay current with LLM capabilities, fine-tuning techniques, and new models
Requirements
1+ year working with LLMs (GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, or equivalent)
Deep understanding of prompt engineering patterns (chain-of-thought, few-shot, RAG)
Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks preferred
Strong analytical mindset - comfortable with A/B testing and iteration
Excellent written English for crafting precise instructions
Skills
LLMs
LangChain
Prompt Design
RAG
Python


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
